{"code": "import requests, json, pandas as pd, sys, textwrap, re, datetime, itertools, math\\nurl = 'https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/query/study_fields'\\nparams = {\\n    'expr': 'helicobacter pylori acne',\\n    'fields': 'NCTId,EnrollmentCount,StartDate,Condition,BriefTitle',\\n    'min_rnk': 1,\\n    'max_rnk': 200,\\n    'fmt': 'json'\\n}\\nresp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=30)\\nprint('Status', resp.status_code)\\nif resp.status_code==200:\\n    data = resp.json()\\n    studies = data.get('StudyFieldsResponse',{}).get('StudyFields',[])\\n    print('Found', len(studies))\\n    # filter for start date within Jan-May 2018\\n    filtered = []\\n    for s in studies:\\n        start = s.get('StartDate', [''])[0]\\n        # parse date maybe like 'January 2018'\\n        if start:\\n            # extract year and month\\n            try:\\n                dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(start, '%B %Y')\\n            except ValueError:\\n                try:\\n                    dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(start, '%Y-%m-%d')\\n                except Exception:\\n                    continue\\n            if dt.year==2018 and 1<=dt.month<=5:\\n                filtered.append(s)\\n    print('Filtered', len(filtered))\\n    for s in filtered:\\n        print(s.get('NCTId'), s.get('EnrollmentCount'), s.get('StartDate'), s.get('Condition'), s.get('BriefTitle'))\\nelse:\\n    print('Error')\\n"}
